direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; main splits into independent reserved zones with no overlap: scene at least 70% of rendered main area, callout zone, station zone and job zone each with fixed tracks; horizontal rail is a single non-wrapping row of 9 equal step targets with aria-current and arrow-key movement; refit tight zones before reducing type; no vertical rail and no inspector scrolling, condense or paginate side content inside its reserved zone; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68); emerald/neon #A8F04A primary with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the required exception; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum throughout, 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge any label under 12px to 12px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array replacing any vertical direction; guide line inside rail zone with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory SVG as the dominant scene; side zone keeps pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main, using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory scene to at least 70% of main and raise all body copy to 16px; shrink the right evidence zone to a fixed reserved track so callouts, stations and jobs never compete for space.
Move the opening-story logo placement into the scene title block at native aspect alongside the header logo, and remove the small duplicate mark above the headline.
Align Certificate 120 and Receiving 80 tracks on one baseline with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap, and add a focus ring to each station node.
Keep Route health pre-flight (nonce, identity) and Investigation source evidence as two independently headed reserved blocks with separate status lines; do not merge their controls.
Enlarge the offline scene to 70% fill and set investigation copy to 16px, condensing the side zone instead of allowing it to scroll.
Make the route selector and Run action at least 40px tall with a visible 2px focus ring and reduced-motion-safe static state text.
Enlarge the comparison scene and raise option body text to 16px; reserve a distinct decision zone on the right with three equal option cards.
State clearly that selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form, keeping the primary disabled until a selection is made.
Link each option card bidirectionally to its route in the SVG so hover, focus and selection highlight both places.
Refit the board into reserved station and job zones at 70% scene fill; the large empty lower task cards waste viewport at 1366x768, so compress card height and surface t2 and t3 detail equally.
Keep proposed tasks labelled untracked until approval in both zones, with 16px task titles and 40px numbered targets 1-3.
Align due-time values between scene and board so the same task shows one consistent value in both zones.
Preserve the preview distinction: CELL-MILL-2 shows preview cross-hatch but only turns stoppedRed after Apply; enlarge route lines and raise labels to 12px minimum.
Raise side-zone body to 16px and fit cell availability, selector and invalidation warning inside its reserved zone without scrolling.
Add pattern plus text to the preview state so meaning survives reduced motion and colour-only reading.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 in stoppedRed with OFFLINE-STOPPED text and cross-hatch, and ensure no feasible route is drawn through it; enlarge the scene to 70% fill.
Repeat the separated pre-flight nonce/identity block and distinct investigation evidence block from step 2 with identical headings for continuity.
Raise the constrained Split card text to 16px and mark it with pattern and an x marker, not colour alone.
Make the constrained Split option non-selectable with a stated reason, pattern fill and disabled pointer style, while the two feasible options remain 40px selectable targets.
Enlarge the scene, set all tradeoff figures in tabular type and keep Human decision status in its own reserved zone at 16px.
Note that selecting a feasible revised option opens the typed consent form, with the primary label reflecting that next action.
Keep 3 blocked prior tasks and 3 proposed replacements as two clearly separated reserved lists coexisting beside the approved revised plan; never merge them into one count.
Compress oversized empty task cards to fit 1366x768, raise task copy to 16px and keep proposed items labelled untracked until approval.
Give the blocked list its hatched pattern and text label so it is distinct from proposed tasks without relying on colour.
Enlarge the three evidence stages into the dominant scene area and raise passphrase guidance to 16px inside a fixed side zone that fits without scrolling.
Sequence Verify, Seal and Retain with locked states explained in text, each control at least 40px with a clear focus ring.
Keep the 70 parts, 35h accepted and 48h comparison metrics tabular and aligned above the evidence zone.
Add a concise completion summary in the scene zone at 16px confirming packet sealed, revised plan accepted and CELL-MILL-2 offline retained, without adding a third logo placement.
Enlarge the three sealed cards to fill the scene more fully and keep check marks paired with SEALED text for non-colour meaning.
Provide one clear exit or restart action in the action bar at 40px, retaining Back and the sealed status line.
